description.value: A private campground alongside Wilson Creek on the Sunshine Coast Highway between Gibsons and Sechelt, with 14 tent sites, flush washrooms, and showers. Right off Hwy 101 with easy access to Davis Bay Beach, groceries, and coffee shops — functional and convenient rather than scenic.

address.value: 4314 Sunshine Coast Hwy, Sechelt, Sunshine Coast BC, Canada V7Z 0B2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is thorough and directly confirms all key details. The home and about pages explicitly list campground amenities including 14 tenting sites, 58 RV/trailer spots, coin-operated laundry, washrooms and showers, and an on-site host. The front page notes walkable access to groceries and coffee shops, and the reservations page confirms phone booking. No evidence for hiker/biker-specific designation, device charging, bike tools, or cyclist discounts was found anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Unknown / Vancouver Island & Gulf Islands' but this campground is on the BC Sunshine Coast (between Sechelt and Gibsons), a distinct region from Vancouver Island — possible miscategorization in the OSM data.
Swimming pool listed as 'currently unavailable' on the website; duration of closure is unknown.
OSM record contains no phone, email, or address tags; all contact details sourced from website only, so contact_confirmed.phone and contact_confirmed.address cannot be cross-checked against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-documented, operating campground with 14 tent sites, showers, laundry, an on-site host, and walkable food access — a solid stop for touring cyclists on the Sunshine Coast.

wow_evidence: coin-operated laundry, washrooms and showers, and an on-site host
